events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 07 (yesterday)): Wingard added Darius Cooper (WR, PHI) for $11 FAAB.
TRADE (Oct 07 (yesterday)): Charles receives Chris Olave (WR, NO), 2027 R2 pick. Wingard receives 2028 R1 pick, 2027 R2 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 06 (2 days ago)): Fronge added Tyler Huntley (QB, BAL) for $21 FAAB (dropped Skyy Moore (WR, GB)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 05 (3 days ago)): Drew added Joe Mixon (RB, FA) for $19 FAAB (dropped DJ Herman (RB, MIA)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (4 days ago)): Brent added Brycen Tremayne (WR, CAR).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (4 days ago)): Mitchum added Jacob Cowing (WR, SF).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 04 (4 days ago)): Drew added Tyler Goodson (RB, DAL) (dropped Emari Demercado (RB, DAL)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 03 (5 days ago)): Ryan added Devontez Walker (WR, BAL).

WEEK 4 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Brent, 139.7-131.1; Jake def. Adam, 122.9-109.6; Wingard def. Drew, 104.0-93.1; Shaq def. Fronge, 138.3-119.6; Charles def. Ryan, 162.2-138.9; Mitchum def. Kevin, 187.8-133.8 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: Mitchum dropped 187.8 on Kevin last week. That is not a typo. One-eighty-seven. DEEP sitting at $82.86 and 6-2 and I am not sure enough people have recalibrated around what this team is right now.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles is 8-0, just added Olave mid-season, and faces the hottest team on the slate this week in Mitchum. The Ledger's Charles-Mitchum preview goes deep on whether 187 points in a win is the kind of thing that follows a defense into the next week or evaporates under undefeated pressure.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I went 2-1 last week and my lock hit, so I am going to need the board to acknowledge that 8-4 with a 1-1 lock record is exactly what steady process looks like. The pick-em standings are not a crisis. They are a leaderboard and I am on the correct end of it.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: People keep tagging me in the 5-7 jokes and I just want to say: yes, I took three favorites last week on record, and I will continue doing so until the math tells me otherwise. Contrarianism for its own sake is how you go from 5-7 to 4-8 faster.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Three weeks ago I said Mitchum was quietly building something real and everyone cited the Deepwater drift narrative like it was gospel. Six and two. One-eighty-seven points last week. The board is right there.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew versus Fronge on Sunday is the most philosophically exhausting game on the Week 5 slate. Atlas is 0-8. ForgeHammer is 2-6 and running its operation out of Havana. One of them gets a win. I genuinely do not know what to do with that information.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Kevin at 5-3 is the quietest legitimate playoff contender in the league right now. RDC at $82.84, middle of the market, and nobody is talking about ksanda until it is too late. Week 5 matchup against Brent is exactly the kind of game that separates the real from the pretenders.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I want a real accounting of what Adam's 2-6 record means for the Helix turnaround thesis. HLX was the market's favorite redemption story entering the season at $79.57, down 7.1%, and now The 100xers are getting picked apart by Jake in blowout fashion. The model-driven narrative needs on-field evidence and it is not showing up.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Shaq went 5-3 without addressing the RB hole for a second straight window, beat Fronge 138-119 last week on WR wealth alone, and now draws Adam in Week 5. MWB at $90.42 is down 4.9% and the market seems to be asking the same question the schedule hasn't forced yet — what happens when the wideouts aren't enough?

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: RYAN LOST TO CHARLES BY 23 AND IS NOW 4-4 AND DRAWING WINGARD IN WEEK 5. AEGIS IS AT $127.96. THIS IS A MUST-WIN GAME FOR A DEFENDING CHAMPION AND I NEED EVERYONE TO TREAT IT LIKE ONE.
